name: Igor Susmelj
bio: Igor Susmelj is co-founder and chief technology officer of Lightly, a Swiss company founded in 2019 out of ETH Zurich research that builds data-curation and self-supervised training tools for computer vision, including the open-source LightlyTrain. Susmelj holds BSc and MSc degrees in electrical engineering from ETH Zurich and previously worked as a software engineer at the Swiss stock exchange.
